acceptance: The TDD floor runs the test-audit check of the Build floor over go/acs/cycle<N>/, through the same function, rules and configuration. There is no second rule list.

A TDD predicate that breaks a test-audit rule (the cycle 2606 shape: a skip that hides an error) is refused at the TDD handoff. The refusal names the rule and the test, and the correction goes to TDD.
evolve phase verify tdd reports the same finding.
A regression test replays the cycle 2606 predicate shape. It fails before the fix and passes after it.
An incident record gives the five occurrences, the root cause and the fix.
fix: Make the TDD floor and evolve phase verify tdd run the same pure-AST test-audit check that the Build floor runs, with the same rules and configuration, over the cycle's predicate package. A refusal goes back to TDD, which owns the file.
source: cycle 2606 retrospective (D1, D2); lessons inst-L2606a and inst-L2599a
summary: The Build floor runs the test-audit ratchet over go/acs/cycle<N>/, but the TDD floor (go/internal/core/tdd_predicate_floor.go) checks only the testdup helper copies. A predicate that breaks a test-audit rule passes the TDD handoff and fails at Build, where the Builder cannot edit the file. Cycle 2606 failed this way with a correct implementation (rule skip-hides-error). This is the 5th occurrence: cycles 1448, 1488, 2532, 2599 and 2606.
title: The TDD floor runs the test-audit ratchet over the predicates that TDD writes
